authorization: Owner selected keeping <=200 ms added delay and separately normalizing cold startup at RTT 100 ms on 2026-10-24
scope: New measurements only. Earlier 100 ms runs remain failed under wan-loss.json; this does not relabel them.
rationale: 14,520-byte initial window at 100 ms RTT has an optimistic ordinary slow-start deficit of about 11.3 MB under a 200 ms queue-age budget; existing 20-second runs lost about 14.2-15.5 MB. Freeze a finite 20 MB cold-start budget (4% at 200 Mbit/s over 20 seconds) before new measurements, with the original >=190 Mbit/s within 2 seconds for 3 seconds and unchanged steady loss/delay/resource checks.
